# Unit test for function strlen
def test_strlen():
    # Basic cases
    assert strlen("") == 0
    assert strlen("a") == 1
    assert strlen("hello") == 5

    # Strings with spaces
    assert strlen(" ") == 1
    assert strlen("hello world") == 11
    assert strlen("   ") == 3

    # Special characters
    assert strlen("!@#$%^&*()") == 10
    assert strlen("\n\t") == 2

    # Unicode strings
    assert strlen("héllo") == 5
    assert strlen("日本語") == 3
    assert strlen("🎉🎊") == 2

    # Long string
    assert strlen("x" * 1000) == 1000

    # Mixed content
    assert strlen("abc123XYZ") == 9

    # Return type check
    result = strlen("test")
    assert isinstance(result, int)
